Synopsis:
The Trump administration has quietly scrubbed critical language about the Confederate Memorial from official government web pages, removing descriptions that characterized the monument as presenting a "mythologized" and sanitized view of slavery. Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth has signaled intent to reinstall the statue at Arlington National Cemetery. The move is part of a broader pattern of the Trump administration reshaping how U.S. cultural, historical, and military institutions present American history, drawing opposition from historians and civil rights advocates.
